name: Bloomberg Law
description: Connect Claude to Bloomberg Law MCP for access to a market-leading collection of federal and state court dockets. Search across cases, parties, courts, judges, filings, and keywords. Retrieve docket details and filing information; monitor matters with alerts and tracks; and surface litigation insights. Built for legal teams that need reliable docket research, case monitoring, and workflow integration powered by Bloomberg Law.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bloomberg Law to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bloomberg Law to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://gw.mcp.bindg.ai/blaw/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bloomberg Law MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bloomberg Law lists 17 MCP tools, including BLAW__docket_download_entry, BLAW__docket_execute_alert_creation, BLAW__docket_execute_filing_request, BLAW__docket_execute_track_creation, BLAW__docket_execute_update_dockets, BLAW__docket_get_docket_cost, BLAW__docket_get_entries, BLAW__docket_get_filing, BLAW__docket_get_metadata, BLAW__docket_get_outcome_prediction, BLAW__docket_get_pleading_cost, and BLAW__docket_preview_alert_creation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bloomberg Law?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bloomberg Law in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: Does Bloomberg Law MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bloomberg Law requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bloomberg Law is developed by Bloomberg Industry Group. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
